title: Mega menu in Menus
problem: A header item could only open a short drop-down list, so big catalogues were hard to browse.
now: Any top header item can open a mega menu of two to five columns with categories, links, a picture or a block; phones get a plain list.
steps: Open Online Store › Menus and edit Accessories
Turn on Open a mega menu, add a Category list for Audio and an image banner
Watch the preview in the panel (it starts with the item's own category), press Done and Save menu
Hover Accessories on the store; on a phone open ☰ and see a normal list
notes: Where: Online Store › Menus (/store-menus), edit a Main menu item
